name: Windows Command Shell
description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell for execution.
detection: Monitor process creation for cmd.exe with unusual parents or interactive recon flags.

name: PowerShell
description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell for execution.
detection: Monitor powershell.exe encoded commands and unusual parent processes.

name: LSASS Memory
description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials from LSASS memory.
detection: Monitor access to lsass.exe and credential dumping tools.

name: Password Guessing
description: Adversaries may use password guessing to gain access.
detection: Monitor failed authentication spikes from single sources.

name: Web Protocols
description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols like HTTP/HTTPS.
detection: Monitor unusual beaconing and rare destinations.

name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
description: Adversaries may achieve persistence via Run keys or startup folders.
detection: Monitor registry Run key modifications and startup folder writes.

name: Spearphishing Attachment
description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with malicious attachments.
detection: Monitor email gateways and endpoint execution from mail clients.

name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
description: Adversaries may use valid accounts with SMB admin shares for lateral movement.
detection: Monitor admin share access (C$, ADMIN$) from unusual hosts.

name: System Information Discovery
description: Adversaries may attempt to get detailed information about the operating system and hardware.
detection: Monitor execution of system discovery binaries such as systeminfo.exe.
